record: AISEF V2 — WP-6.2 PRE-CODE SCHEMA-FIT AUDIT
candidate_audited: 116b92a39ef5bff2846ab8978550276f446d8a5d (WP-6.1 candidate; the frozen vocabulary at HEAD)

journal_behaviour.rollback_without_failure_refused: JournalError: story/rollback cites exactly one failure/observed
journal_behaviour.provider_request_for_a_non_ready_criteri: ProjectionError: budgets: provider/request for S1 charges ['C2'], not admitted READY (§14: PRE_SATISFIED consumes no developer budget)
journal_behaviour.failure_for_a_story_that_never_began_ref: ProjectionError: story_state: failure/observed for story S0 in state None: not a §17 transition
journal_behaviour.unschematised_type_refused_at_append: JournalError: proof/verified has no payload schema in journal format 2; writing it is a format version bump (§35)
journal_behaviour.tests_adequacy_refused_at_append: JournalError: tests/adequacy has no payload schema in journal format 2; writing it is a format version bump (§35)
journal_behaviour.foreign_code_refused: JournalError: failure/observed: code 'MERGE_CONFLICT' is not a taxonomy code; a foreign error flattens to UNKNOWN (§22)
journal_behaviour.unknown_needs_original: JournalError: failure/observed: a foreign error flattens to UNKNOWN and keeps its original as data; only UNKNOWN carries one (§22)
journal_behaviour.gate_decision_cites_gate_checks_only: JournalError: gate/decision cites [4]: not a gate/check with the same gate

fit_table.path: run begin / RunSpec / capabilities / shutdown / interruption
plan frozen (identity of the plan the run executes)
plan static admission record
fit_table.how: no schema in any format; not required by the WP-6.2 path: StaticPlanAdmission is a plan-time record, re-derived by require_admitted at freeze, and plan/frozen carries the frozen identity

fit_table.path: story begin / admission / probe records at the parent / plan drift
admission refusal (PRECONDITION_BROKEN, PLAN_CONTRADICTION, PROBE_UNRUNNABLE, PROBE_INVALID)
fit_table.how: codes PRECONDITION_BROKEN (PLAN, N), PLAN_CONTRADICTION (PLAN, N), PROBE_UNRUNNABLE (ENVIRONMENT, R), PROBE_INVALID_SPEC (INTEGRATION, N); story/rollback cites the failure; story_state allows ROLLBACK from BEGIN

fit_table.path: resources of the story scope
developer provider call and its result
fit_table.how: provider/request {story_id, criteria} charges the developer budget per READY criterion (§14); provider/result COMPLETED/FAILED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN cites it

fit_table.path: provider outage mid-story
fit_table.how: PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE (PROVIDER, R): the retry charges the PROVIDER budget (budget.charge), never DEVELOPER; MISSING_CREDENTIAL / INVALID_CREDENTIAL (ENVIRONMENT) for credentials

fit_table.path: developer tool execution (a tool that fails or dies)
fit_table.how: P4 ToolCall; a tool exit status is a fact, never an owner: product truth is measured at the candidate

fit_table.path: candidate proof (implementer) and independent verification (verifier), agreement
fit_table.how: proof/verified has no schema in any format (measured: refused at append). The two ProbeRecords are journaled as probe/evaluated (typed: spec_id, semantic_hash, probe id/digest, revision, enforcement, result); agreement and verdict are derivable from those typed records; the commit decision is gate/check rows (one per obligation, `check` = the criterion id, `passed` = agreement and verdict == expectation) and a gate/decision citing them by seq. No prose is read. A dedicated VerifiedProof event stays unavailable.

fit_table.path: candidate proof failure (contract unsatisfied / subject absent / harness cannot run / non-controller signal)
fit_table.how: CONTRACT_UNSATISFIED (DEVELOPER, R), SUBJECT_ABSENT_AT_CANDIDATE (DEVELOPER, R), PROBE_UNRUNNABLE (ENVIRONMENT, R), NON_CONTROLLER_SIGNAL (INTEGRATION, N), PROBE_INVALID_SPEC (INTEGRATION, N) via routing.route

fit_table.path: verifier disagreement => INDETERMINATE / INTEGRATION / stop
fit_table.missing: FailureCode VERIFIER_DISAGREEMENT (owner INTEGRATION, NOT_RETRYABLE) — RFC §16 rule 3
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: the INTEGRATION codes are PROBE_INVALID_SPEC (not evaluable by this probe), POST_MERGE_* (another measurement point), NON_CONTROLLER_SIGNAL (a typed probe reason) and UNKNOWN (a flattened non-AISEF error that must carry `original`): each would overload an unrelated code and silently convert a typed disagreement into another failure class; without a failure/observed the story cannot ROLLBACK (measured: refused) and the run cannot shut down with the story open

fit_table.path: instrument identity mismatch between implementer and verifier records (PROBE_MISMATCH, §16 rule 2)
fit_table.missing: FailureCode PROBE_MISMATCH (owner INTEGRATION, NOT_RETRYABLE) — RFC §16 names it as a harness integrity failure

fit_table.path: engineering-quality checks (EngineeringTestAdequacy) — recorded
fit_table.missing: a payload schema for tests/adequacy (F1 vocabulary member with no schema in format 1 or 2; measured: refused at append) — the format bump V2-004 names
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: gate/check carries one bool per row: the three-valued AdequacyOutcome, the typed TestExecution axes, Vacuity and Relevance would be flattened into booleans or moved into `detail` prose — a silent conversion, and prose as the only carrier

fit_table.path: engineering-quality checks — UNRUNNABLE execution => environment failure (§15.3)
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: PROBE_UNRUNNABLE is the observation harness of a ProductProofSpec probe; developer tests are not a probe (invariant III): overloading

fit_table.path: engineering-quality checks — INADEQUATE => DEVELOPER (where policy permits blocking, §15.3)
fit_table.missing: FailureCode TESTS_INADEQUATE (DEVELOPER, RESOLVED_BY_POLICY) — V2-004 member 2; and TESTS_NOT_COLLECTABLE_UNDETERMINED (INTEGRATION, NOT_RETRYABLE) — V2-004 member 3
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: CONTRACT_UNSATISFIED / SUBJECT_ABSENT_AT_CANDIDATE are product-proof codes (§10.3): using them for a developer-test outcome lets developer tests reach the product-proof owner row — exactly what §8/§15 forbid

fit_table.path: reviewer (model) request and result
fit_table.missing: a representation of a non-developer provider call: provider/request has no role field and the frozen budgets projection charges every provider/request to the developer per READY criterion (measured)
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: journaling a reviewer call as provider/request cross-charges the developer budget (drops owner information); not journaling it leaves a control input un-backed

fit_table.path: reviewer blocking finding => owner REVIEW
fit_table.missing: any FailureCode owned by REVIEW (the taxonomy has none; measured)
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: no code carries owner REVIEW; a model review alone may not block (§25), so the typed REVIEW-owned outcome that may be recorded is undefined in the taxonomy

fit_table.path: reviewer environment failure => ENVIRONMENT, never DEVELOPER (ORCH-6)
fit_table.missing: an ENVIRONMENT code for a review/security capability that cannot run (e.g. REVIEW_UNRUNNABLE, ENVIRONMENT, retryable)
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: PROBE_UNRUNNABLE names the ProductProofSpec observation harness; MISSING/INVALID_CREDENTIAL fit only a credential failure: a reviewer that cannot launch would overload PROBE_UNRUNNABLE

fit_table.path: security scanner executes and finds issues => EXECUTED, never UNRUNNABLE (ORCH-7); findings => owner SECURITY
fit_table.missing: any FailureCode owned by SECURITY (the taxonomy has none; measured)
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: the execution itself fits (tool/invoked + tool/result COMPLETED/FAILED is EXECUTED, not UNRUNNABLE); the typed outcome of the findings has no code, so the story cannot stop on them with an owner

fit_table.path: merge (the merged revision)
fit_table.how: story/commit carries the full merged SHA

fit_table.path: merge conflict => INTEGRATION, zero developer charge (ORCH-8)
fit_table.missing: FailureCode MERGE_CONFLICT (owner INTEGRATION; retryability an owner decision) — RFC §26
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: POST_MERGE_REGRESSION / POST_MERGE_SUBJECT_LOST describe a probe outcome after a merge that succeeded; UNKNOWN requires a flattened foreign error; a merge conflict is a typed AISEF condition with no code (measured: a foreign code string is refused at append)

fit_table.path: post-merge re-proof of the merged story and affected prior PRESERVE obligations; regression => INTEGRATION
fit_table.how: records carry the merged revision (typed); the codes exist (INTEGRATION, N); a failure/observed after story/commit is accepted (measured) so the regression is attributed to the merged story's attempt; a prior story's obligation is re-proved under the merged story's id (a failure for a story that never began is refused — measured)

fit_table.path: environment failure while acquiring a scope resource (worktree, sandbox)
fit_table.missing: an ENVIRONMENT code for a resource the harness could not acquire (story/resource-released covers releases only)
fit_table.why_no_existing_code_fits: only credential codes and PROBE_UNRUNNABLE are ENVIRONMENT-owned: overloading

fit_table.path: integration failure from a foreign error (an OSError from git, an unexpected exception)
fit_table.how: owner.flatten -> UNKNOWN (INTEGRATION, N) with `original` retained — its defined meaning

fit_table.path: control decisions (commit gate, post-merge gate, migration seam refusal)
fit_table.how: one gate/check row per check (typed passed), gate/decision cites the rows by seq and names the projections it read; a decision cannot cite anything but gate/check rows (measured)

fit_table.path: HUMAN_DECLARATION_REQUIRED migration row => refusal before any provider request (ORCH-13)
fit_table.how: the seam refuses before plan/frozen; the refusal is journal-backed as gate rows; no story begins, no provider/request exists

fit_table.path: retry / rollback decisions from typed owner + retryability + budgets projection
invariant violation
fit_table.how: not journaled: InvariantError escapes (uncontainable) and the run-lifetime / TORN semantics apply (owner §3); invariant/violated stays unschematised and unused

FITS: run begin / RunSpec / capabilities / shutdown / interruption
plan frozen (identity of the plan the run executes)
story begin / admission / probe records at the parent / plan drift
developer provider call and its result
developer tool execution (a tool that fails or dies)
candidate proof failure (contract unsatisfied / subject absent / harness cannot run / non-controller signal)
post-merge re-proof of the merged story and affected prior PRESERVE obligations; regression => INTEGRATION
integration failure from a foreign error (an OSError from git, an unexpected exception)
control decisions (commit gate, post-merge gate, migration seam refusal)
retry / rollback decisions from typed owner + retryability + budgets projection
FITS_VIA_TYPED_COMPOSITION: candidate proof (implementer) and independent verification (verifier), agreement
HUMAN_DECLARATION_REQUIRED migration row => refusal before any provider request (ORCH-13)
DOES_NOT_FIT: instrument identity mismatch between implementer and verifier records (PROBE_MISMATCH, §16 rule 2)
engineering-quality checks — UNRUNNABLE execution => environment failure (§15.3)
engineering-quality checks — INADEQUATE => DEVELOPER (where policy permits blocking, §15.3)
reviewer environment failure => ENVIRONMENT, never DEVELOPER (ORCH-6)
security scanner executes and finds issues => EXECUTED, never UNRUNNABLE (ORCH-7); findings => owner SECURITY
merge conflict => INTEGRATION, zero developer charge (ORCH-8)
environment failure while acquiring a scope resource (worktree, sandbox)

conclusion: STOP BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION: required paths do not fit the current frozen vocabulary.

missing_representations.name: (an ENVIRONMENT code for a review/security capability or a scope resource that cannot run)
proof/verified
missing_representations.rfc: §16, §20.1 (representable meanwhile as probe/evaluated x2 + gate rows)

missing_representations.name: the role of a provider/request (developer vs reviewer), or a separate review event
missing_representations.rfc: §25; the budgets projection (F11) reads provider/request as a developer charge

v2_004.status: PROPOSED — NOT APPROVED — NOT APPLIED — NOT CONSUMED
v2_004.reasoning: V2-004 (three TESTS_* codes bound to a format-3 tests/adequacy schema) covers exactly the engineering-quality paths (three of the DOES_NOT_FIT rows). The verifier-disagreement, probe-mismatch, merge-conflict, review/security-owned and environment-acquisition paths, and the reviewer provider-request role, are outside it and need their own owner decision (a broader exception, or a cycle-1 scoping ruling that keeps review/security outcomes non-blocking and non-journaled).
